items.title: The race to find routes around the Strait of Hormuz and which nation is winning
items.description: Amid uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz, for months Gulf countries and oil companies have been finding ways to bypass the choke point.

items.title: Refinery shortages create new fuel crisis
items.description: There is a rapidly escalating supply crunch that has yet to show up on oil markets. While the price of crude has risen in the past week as the fragile Iran war ceasefire has crumbled, the remarkably restrained price moves have helped create a false sense of security.

items.title: Subsidy changes prompt battery installation collapse
items.description: Federal subsidies have ignited huge demand for batteries, but a tightening of the rules has experts warning of "boom and bust" cycles for the industry.

items.title: There's something odd about most couples. Geneticists and sociologists have noticed it too
items.description: Once I saw it, I couldn't unsee it. Had I noticed something real or was it just the people around me? I set out to find out what the data had to say.

items.title: Malcolm Roberts falsely claimed COVID-19 vaccines caused miscarriages
items.description: The One Nation senator made the previously unreported remarks during a live stream discussion with three prominent Australian anti-vaccine mandate activists.

items.title: Hanson dodges questions about who paid for Italy trip
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson refuses to say who paid for her recent trip to Italy, where she attended a fashion show and was spotted at a five-star resort.

items.title: Australian stuns The Open with equal lowest round in major golf history
items.description: Australia's Lucas Herbert takes a shock lead at The Open after posting a stunning round where he birdied six of his opening nine holes.

items.title: 'Bring back public flogging': Inquiry hears of vicious online trolling
items.description: Racial slurs, online trolls and fears of far-right violence have taken a toll on First Nations people, a federal inquiry heard this week.

items.title: Sam Neill's advice for when the world seems too dark
items.description: The world has been remembering Sam Neill's incredible film and television career in the wake of the actor's death, but his off-screen antics left a robust impact.

items.title: Lao authorities charge distillery owners over fatal methanol poisoning
items.description: Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles, both 19, died after the incident at the Nana Backpackers Hostel in Vang Vieng in November 2024.

items.title: Antisemitism inquiry turns uncomfortable lens on university protests
items.description: Universities have apologised to Jewish staff and students who have spoken of their distress at being targeted by protest movement.

items.title: The quote that shows the divide within Australia's Commonwealth Games team
items.description: While a Commonwealth Games gold rush is always expected for Australia's swimmers, the emerging generation of track and field athletes see Glasgow as a chance to make their mark on a global stage.

items.title: 'Palestine will disappear before our eyes': Calls for Israel to stop settlements
items.description: The two former world leaders are demanding the international community heap more pressure on Israel to change course.

items.title: Burnham to become next UK PM after Australian candidate gets one vote
items.description: Andy Burnham will be Britain's seventh prime minister in 10 years next week after winning a Labour leadership contest in which his only challenger, an Australian, received just one vote.

items.title: From Book Doof to bedazzling, social reading is all the rage
items.description: People find community with other bookworms as social reading takes off with everything from literature raves to book bedazzling.

items.title: Grey's Anatomy mixed with Bump and Scrubs: Welcome to The F Ward
items.description: Growing up, Ioane Sa'ula thought he'd probably play rugby league professionally, but an injury scuppered his plans. Now, he's the romantic lead of new Aussie medical drama, The F Ward.

items.title: ABC 5050 quiz: Testing your knowledge of Sam Neill's Marvel cameo, 70s punk rock and traffic cones
items.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But there's a catch.

items.title: Brenda Fricker, Oscar-winning Irish actress, dies aged 81
items.description: Brenda Fricker became the first Irish actress to win an Oscar for the 1989 film My Left Foot and also played the kindly Pigeon Lady in Home Alone 2.

items.title: Cricket legend Sir Garfield Sobers dies aged 89
items.description: Sir Don Bradman once described Sobers as "the greatest all-round cricketer I ever saw".

items.title: City investors buy shares in oysters, cows and bumper crops
items.description: An Australian investment platform is helping farmers raise capital by connecting them with everyday investors who can buy shares in crops and livestock while sharing the risks and rewards of farming.

items.title: 'Unethical': Minister admits big tech firms use Aussie content without artists' permission
items.description: Australian artists have already had their music taken to train overseas AI models without payment or consent.

items.title: No guarantee outages won't happen again, Telstra CEO says
items.description: The national Telstra outage last week was triggered by maintenance work that caused the system's clocks to go back two decades, the telco says.

items.title: Eight killed, dozens missing as landslide buries people in China
items.description: A landslide in south-western China's Chongqing municipality has buried people in rubble and destroyed a roadway and a number of buildings, according to state media.

items.title: Trump's speech a desperate move — and 'ominous sign' ahead of midterms
items.description: Using a prime-time address to the nation to repeat long-debunked claims about the 2020 election defeat is a desperate and unusual move. Analysts say it's an "ominous sign" of how Donald Trump may handle the upcoming midterms.

items.title: Ukraine says it destroyed Russian bomber at Engels airbase
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the military plane was used by Russia for missile strikes on Ukraine.
